drafts.body:
DRAFT - NOT FILED. File only after the brand owner approves it and has signed a Letter of Authorisation.

Hello Global Domain Group LLC abuse team,

The domain mynearwallet[.]xyz (registered with you on 2026-07-15) is being used to impersonate MyNearWallet, a crypto project whose official site is hxxps://mynearwallet[.]com. We ask you to suspend the domain under your abuse policy and the RAA section 3.18 obligations.

Evidence (observed 2026-11-01, read-only, URLs defanged):
- URL: hxxps://mynearwallet[.]xyz/
- Official name on a different TLD
- Hostname contains a lure word (claim/airdrop/support/...)
- Page title resembles the official title (100%)
- Brand named on the page (3x), including the title
- Resolves to 188.114.97.3, 188.114.96.3
- Page title: "Mynearwallet"
- Screenshot: shots/mynearwallet.xyz.jpg (attach)

We are not affiliated with the operator of mynearwallet[.]xyz. MyNearWallet has not authorised its use of the brand. Screenshots and HTML captures are available on request.

Regards,
{{REPORTER_NAME}}
{{REPORTER_ORG}}, acting for MyNearWallet under a Letter of Authorisation dated {{LOA_DATE}}
